verdict.rationale: Salv documents webhooks that notify the client of events such as new alerts, but nothing in the evidence covers payload signing or authenticity verification, event IDs, retry semantics, or idempotency for deduplicating retried deliveries. The alert suppression interval governs alert generation, not webhook redelivery, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify alert-event authenticity and deduplicate retried notifications
